title: Maximum Number of Tasks You Can Assign
summary: Given n tasks and m workers with strength requirements and strengths, respectively, and a limited number of magical pills that can increase worker strength by a fixed amount, determine the maximum number of tasks that can be completed by assigning each task to a worker with sufficient strength, allowing each worker to receive at most one pill.
statement: Given n tasks and m workers with strength requirements and strengths, respectively, and a limited number of magical pills that can increase worker strength by a fixed amount, determine the maximum number of tasks that can be completed by assigning each task to a worker with sufficient strength, allowing each worker to receive at most one pill.
constraints: Each task and worker may be used at most once; a worker completes a task when its strength meets the requirement.
At most pills workers may each receive one strength boost.
Return the largest number of tasks that can be assigned.
hints: Whether x tasks can be completed is monotone, so binary-search x.
For a candidate x, use the x easiest tasks and x strongest workers; feed each worker all newly reachable tasks into a deque.
Without a pill take the easiest task the worker can do; otherwise spend a pill on the hardest reachable task.
This exchange strategy preserves easy tasks for weaker workers and uses every pill where it unlocks the most demanding available task.
editorial: This exchange strategy preserves easy tasks for weaker workers and uses every pill where it unlocks the most demanding available task.

tests.explanation: All three tasks can be assigned by boosting the zero-strength worker for task one.
Only one worker can be boosted, so only one task is completed.
